scope: Verified saved-result and implementation summary; private raw source receipts are not distributed.

methods.biomass_observation_equation: Total algal biomass was evaluated against a chlorophyll-derived dry-weight proxy, B_obs [gDW m−3] = Chl-a [µg L−1] / 10. This conversion assumes 10 mg Chl-a gDW−1 (equivalently, a dry-weight:chlorophyll mass ratio of 100); it is a fixed proxy conversion rather than a direct dry-weight measurement. Model predictions were expressed as B_pred = s ζ <B_surface>, where ζ = 15.300047 gDW m−3 per state unit, s = 1.45, and the brackets denote the normalized station-neighborhood weighted hourly values averaged over the UTC day used for the biomass evaluation. The coefficient s was applied after ecological integration and was not applied to toxin sources.
methods.scale_selection_correction: The observation-expression coefficient 1.45 was selected from the previously examined set {1.00, 1.19, 1.25, 1.45} using the shared 141-record development sample from 2020–2022 and was applied equally to the metabolic-capacity and empirical-capacity predictions. It was then frozen for the 2019 conditional holdout. The retained selection record identifies 1.45 as a conservative prior-grid value; it does not define a joint two-model calibration objective. For context, the same archived R18 development states had a continuous log10-MAE-minimizing scalar of 1.4407366 and a geometric-mean-unbiased scalar of 1.5409816. These are diagnostics from the earlier configuration, not new fits to the f63 results.
methods.initial_survey_in_errors: The reported 181-record biomass evaluation includes the first-survey dates used to constrain initialization: 8 records on July 22, 2019; 5 on July 20, 2020; 8 on August 9, 2021; and 8 on July 6, 2022 (29 records in total). Consequently, these errors combine initialization-date and subsequent-date performance; they are conditional on survey-informed initial biomass.
methods.observational_regression: For the contemporaneous observational diagnostic, define H = Chl-a/(1 µg L−1), Y = (C_MC + 0.01 µg L−1)/(1 µg L−1), and x = log10(H). In each leave-one-year-out fold, ordinary least squares estimated log10(Y) = a + b(x − x̄_train) using the other two years. Holdout concentrations were C_hat = max[(10^(a+b(x−x̄_train)) − 0.01) µg L−1, 0]. The same 124 surface station-days from 2020–2022 were used throughout; censored particulate and dissolved components were each replaced by LOD/2 before summation. No retransformation smearing correction was used. The pooled holdout MAE, n−1 Σ|log10[(C_hat+0.01)/(1 µg L−1)] − log10[(C_MC+0.01)/(1 µg L−1)]|, was 0.244396 (0.244 when rounded), in dimensionless base-10 logarithmic units. The fraction within a factor of two on this offset scale was 89/124 = 71.8%. This is a same-day measured-Chl-a diagnostic and is separate from the four-year 164-record modeled-input evaluation.
methods.main_initialization: Initial toxin pools for the main lake configuration were generated by repeating the first 72 h of source forcing for 30 cycles with a 1 h step and no observation fitting. The per-grid relative-change tolerance was 10−6. None of the 12 year–formulation runs met strict convergence: the converged fraction was zero, and the maximum relative change in the final active cycle ranged from 0.0208751 to 0.0210043. The declared cycle-30 pool states were retained and transferred to recipient inventories using the source control volumes; no additional mobile-transport spin-up was performed. These numerical initial pools are not equilibrium states or measured initial conditions.
methods.initialization_scope_limit: The main lake stage sequence is conditional on these declared initial pools. The available zero-, doubled-, extended-spin-up-, current-input-only-, and initial-inventory-only checks belong to the separate 7555-record supplementary water-column configuration. They do not establish initialization robustness of the 67452-record main lake stage statistics.

biomass.proxy_conversion_bibliographic_reference: UNCONFIRMED: no identifiable original citation found in the checked implementation/manuscript records; describe as assumed fixed conversion unless an actual source is recovered.
biomass.joint_calibration_objective: UNCONFIRMED_NOT_DOCUMENTED; retained provenance says selected conservative prior-grid value, not joint optimization.
biomass.temporal_basis: UTC calendar-day arithmetic hourly mean, as implemented in the biomass extractor; this is distinct from the complete America/Detroit local-day MC extraction.

observational_regression.formula: log10((C_MC+0.01 ug/L)/(1 ug/L)) = a + b*(log10(Chl-a/(1 ug/L)) - x_training_center)
observational_regression.error_units: dimensionless base-10 logarithmic units of concentration plus 0.01 ug/L

spinup_strict_convergence.state_interpretation: Declared cycle-30 pools; not equilibrium or measured initial pools.
